questions.q: At what age did the Prophet SAW begin withdrawing to seek guidance?
questions.explain: At 38 he began to withdraw to seek guidance.

questions.q: Where did the Prophet SAW practise tahannuth?
options: In the Cave of Hira on Jabal Nur
questions.explain: He stayed for days, sometimes a month, in a small cave on Jabal Nur.
Tahannuth is withdrawing to worship and reflect, like the Prophet in the Cave of Hira.

questions.q: Who climbed the hill to bring supplies and wrap him in a blanket without asking questions?
How many times did Jibril embrace him before delivering the first verses?
questions.explain: He was embraced three times and told to read.

questions.q: What was the first word of revelation in Surah Al-Alaq?
questions.explain: The first verse, Al-Alaq 96:1, tells him to read in the name of his Lord who created.

questions.q: In which month did the Quran begin to be revealed?
questions.explain: The Quran began to be revealed in Ramadan, possibly on an odd night such as the 21st.

questions.q: What did Khadijah do when he came home frightened?
options: Wrapped him in a blanket and held him until his breathing calmed
questions.explain: Khadijah wrapped him up and held him until his breathing was calm.

questions.q: The Arabs were known for strong memories because they memorised lineages and poetry.
questions.explain: True. That is why they could memorise the Quran easily.

questions.q: Although rich and famous, the Prophet SAW no longer helped the poor.
questions.explain: False. He always helped those in need in Makkah.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: He practises tahannuth in the Cave of Hira
He returns home and Khadijah wraps him

questions.explain: He withdrew, practised tahannuth, his dreams came true, the revelation came, and he returned to be wrapped by Khadijah.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A small cave that fits only one person
The noble night among the last ten nights of Ramadan
Allah's message conveyed to the prophets

questions.explain: Jabal Nur is the Mountain of Light, Hira a small cave on it, wahy is Allah's message, and Laylatul Qadr is the noble night in Ramadan.
